def verify_costas(perm):
    n = len(perm)
    vectors = []
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i+1, n):
            dr = perm[j] - perm[i]
            dc = j - i
            vectors.append((dr, dc))
    print(f"Number of vectors: {len(vectors)}")
    print(f"Unique vectors: {len(set(vectors))}")
    if len(vectors) == len(set(vectors)):
        print("Valid Costas array!")
    else:
        print("Invalid - duplicate vectors found")
        from collections import Counter
        c = Counter(vectors)
        for v, count in c.items():
            if count > 1:
                print(f"  Duplicate: {v} appears {count} times")
    return vectors

perm = (0, 1, 5, 3, 6, 2, 4)
vectors = verify_costas(perm)
print(f"\nPermutation: {list(perm)}")
print(f"Vectors: {sorted(vectors)}")
